seo_title: Cost of Living in Astana 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Astana per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: Visa-free entry for 90 days, Russian used in everyday life and minimal bureaucracy for Russian citizens. A modern capital with a growing IT scene and new housing — but with harsh steppe winters.
pros: Visa-free entry for 90 days, Russian used everywhere in daily life
Minimal bureaucracy: an IIN and a bank account in 1–2 days
Low cost of living and modern new housing
Convenient fintech: Kaspi and Halyk — transfers and payments in a couple of clicks
Direct flights to Moscow and a growing IT scene (Astana Hub)
cons: Very harsh winters: frosts down to −30 to −40 and strong steppe winds
Little greenery, flat terrain, a city that gets blown through
Heat and dust in summer — a sharply continental climate
Rents rose after the influx of relocators in 2022–2023

visa_steps.title: Visa-free entry
visa_steps.description: Up to 90 days within 180 — you only need a passport, the stamp is issued at the border.

visa_steps.title: Registration
visa_steps.description: The host (the landlord or hotel) notifies the migration service within 3 days.

visa_steps.title: IIN
visa_steps.description: An individual identification number at a Public Service Centre — needed for a bank, a rental and a SIM card.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Kaspi, Halyk or Freedom Bank open accounts for Russians with a passport and IIN.

visa_steps.title: Residence permit (optional)
visa_steps.description: Through employment, business, study or family reunification — a path to long-term status.

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Astana?
faq.answer: No, visa-free entry for up to 90 days per six months. For long-term stays you obtain a residence permit or a status through work/study.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Astana?
faq.answer: Kazakh is the state language, but almost everyone understands Russian, and it's ubiquitous in daily life and business.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Astana?
faq.answer: The MIR card doesn't work. It's easier to open a local Kaspi or Halyk card — that's a matter of 1–2 days.

faq.question: How harsh is the winter in Astana?
faq.answer: Very: frosts down to −30 to −40 with wind are not rare. It's one of the coldest capitals in the world, warm clothing is a must.

faq.question: How is it with work and IT in Astana?
faq.answer: The market is growing, there's the Astana Hub tech park; most relocators work remotely for foreign or Russian companies.

faq.question: Is Astana safe?
faq.answer: Yes, the level of petty crime is low, the city is calm and well-lit.

reviews.text: I arrived with a single suitcase and within two days I had an IIN and a Kaspi card. Winter is tough — minus forty with wind — but in summer and autumn the city is great, and daily life is cheap.
We rented a two-room apartment on the Left Bank, everything new and convenient. Russian everywhere, almost zero adaptation. The main downside — the climate and the lack of greenery.
